<div class="subtitle-note">
Assistive robotics · Physical human-robot interaction · Wearable robotics
</div>

I design clinically validated systems that sense human intent from wearable
sensors (EMG, IMU) and turn it into real-time robotic assistance — powered
exoskeletons, actuated ankle-foot orthoses, and functional electrical
stimulation. My current interests include physics-based modeling, model-based
control, and multimodal AI for understanding and predicting human motion.
